```{r extended-examples, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
example_source <- readLines("../vignettes_ext/extended_example.Rmd", warn = FALSE)
header_end <- which(example_source == "---")[2]
example_text <- knitr::knit_child(text = example_source[-seq_len(header_end)], quiet = TRUE)
figure_root <- dirname(dirname(sub("/$", "", knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.path"))))
example_text <- gsub(paste0(normalizePath(figure_root, winslash = "/"), "/"), "", example_text, fixed = TRUE)
example_text <- gsub("(?m)^(#>.*?)[ \\t]+$", "\\1", example_text, perl = TRUE)
cat(example_text, sep = "\n")
```
